The account-deletion request uses a destructive-operation confirmation and invalidates sessions per PRD 10.
Counter and outbox instrumentation activates only behind an explicit opt-in, never on normal startup, and writes no secrets or private content to logs.
Existing verified behavior (inbox search and filters, projects board, subtasks and activity history, focus lifecycle, auth recovery pages) keeps passing.

candidate.cost: Small: one column plus renderer text on the new sessions list.
candidate.product_value: Users can spot unfamiliar device activity and revoke precisely, deepening trust in the account surface.
candidate.rationale: A last-active timestamp per session row makes revocation decisions meaningful once the PRD-required sessions list exists.
candidate.risk: Low; timestamps must not leak more than non-secret metadata.

acceptance: A deletion request can be cancelled within its window, and sessions still invalidate immediately per PRD 10.
candidate.cost: Medium: a scheduled expiry job or lazily evaluated deadline plus a cancel action and UI state.
candidate.product_value: Users can undo an accidental deletion request, matching the recovery-and-retry product character.
candidate.rationale: A bounded cancel window between deletion request and execution gives the destructive operation a recoverable path where PRD 10 says when possible.
candidate.risk: Must not delay session invalidation required by PRD 10, or the security posture regresses.

task_specification.objective: Close the last missing PRD-8 Settings capability (password change, session management, account-deletion request) as a working, security-preserving product increment, and add the opt-in, isolated candidate-side surfaces that make the Host's external lanes drivable: focusboard:// activations that increment the delivery counters, and verification/reset/reminder links readable from the local mail-sink outbox by an external typed journey.

diagnosis.root_cause: Two compounding causes. Product: PRD 8 Settings depth (password change, session management, account-deletion request) has never been implemented - SettingsView still renders only Profile and Reminder deliveries, a plain missing implementation that loops 12-14 did not target. Evidence: the external-activation and typed-journey lanes are measurement debt - the collector cannot activate focusboard:// from outside the process, so candidate probe counters sit at warm=0/cold=0 and the only section-3 verdict remains the untrusted renderer self-drive; candidate instrumentation to date is probe-only and never incrementable by a real external activation, and mail links are not externally readable. Repeating collector retries or adding unrelated product slices cannot move either cause; this loop pairs the missing Settings implementation with genuinely drivable, opt-in, isolated activation surfaces so Host recapture can finally bind receipts.

stop_conditions: If any instrumentation would create test accounts, consume mail tokens, or mutate data on normal product startup, stop and gate it behind an explicit, isolated opt-in instead.
If OS-level focusboard:// registration cannot be made observable in the unbundled runtime, report the specific registration gap as blocked rather than claiming counters moved.
If the sessions or deletion schema change risks a lossy migration of existing data, stop until a lossless, unit-proven migration exists.
If password change or deletion would break the working register/verify/reset/sign-in journeys, stop and preserve those flows first.
If the opt-in surfaces cannot keep tokens and passwords out of logs, stop and redact before shipping.

strategy.rationale: Loops 12-14 ran vertical product slices plus probe-only instrument readiness, yet the external lanes stayed not_run and Settings depth was never touched. This strategy changes both levers: ship the last missing PRD-8 capability as the product increment, and convert activation evidence from probe-only to externally drivable (real activations increment counters; mail-sink links readable outside the process; strictly opt-in and isolated). Host owns the external lanes and recapture; if its lane still cannot fire, the two evidence issues take an explicit environment-unavailable disposition rather than a seventh silent retry.

evidence_resolution.rationale: find.deeplink-scheme-not-registered and find.first-run-gui-drive-missing are evidence-stalled because the collector cannot activate focusboard:// from outside the process and the only section-3 verdict is the untrusted renderer self-drive. The candidate-side fix is not another probe but drivable surfaces: real-activation counter increments plus a machine-readable mail-sink outbox, explicitly opt-in and isolated from normal user data, so the Host external lanes can produce bound receipts. Waiving is premature because the frozen acceptance (counters moving off zero during a signed-in scenario) becomes measurable once activation is drivable.

tasks.instructions: Implement the missing PRD 8 Settings depth as working vertical slices: password change (current-password check, policy validation with an actionable message, other sessions invalidated on success), session management (list active sessions with non-secret device metadata, revoke one, revoke all), and an account-deletion request with explicit destructive confirmation that invalidates sessions; each section carries loading, error, and success states. Then add the opt-in external-activation evidence surfaces: real focusboard:// warm/cold activations increment the existing delivery counters so the collector lane can read them off zero, and verification, reset, and reminder emails expose their action links through a machine-readable local mail-sink outbox an external journey can follow. Instrumentation must be explicitly opted in, isolated from normal user data and sessions, never triggered by normal startup, and free of cleartext tokens or passwords in logs. Keep nav semantics machine-readable (aria-current plus stable per-item nav labels and the hydration marker) so a corrected Host hydration matcher can match. Preserve parameterized SQL, user-scoped ownership checks, rate limiting, hashed passwords never returned, and all existing verified surfaces.

risk_note.summary: Highest validation risk is that the Host external-activation lane still cannot fire in this environment, leaving counters and outbox unused and the two evidence issues unresolved a seventh loop.
risk_note.validation: Developer self-validates counter increments and outbox writes via an explicit opt-in local activation and a mail-sink message; Host replay recapture in validation decides the issues, with an explicit environment-unavailable disposition as the bounded fallback.
risk_note.why_now: Both evidence issues are strategy_exhausted after six-plus treatment loops, and Settings depth is the last missing PRD-8 capability failing the phase gate; neither moves without this pairing.
